newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian tribunal says no wage ruling Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Australian tribunal says no wage ruling Wednesday.

text.p: The Australian Industrial Relations Commission (IRC) said on Wednesday it would not be handing down a ruling on the national "living wage" case today, despite bond market speculation of an imminent decision.
"It's not on the list today," an IRC spokesman told Reuters.
He added the parties to the case would be given 24 hours advanced warning of a decision.
The trade union movement has claimed a rise in all award wage levels of A$20 a week plus 8.75 percent, and then two further A$20 rises over the next two years.
The government, which has sought an A$8 weekly rise, has called the union claim irresponsible and the Reserve Bank has said the case could markedly affect Australia's ability to hold down inflation.
